Add, list, upgrade, or remove configured plugin marketplaces

Usage: codex plugin marketplace [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  add      Add a configured plugin marketplace
  list     List configured plugin marketplaces
  upgrade  Upgrade configured plugin marketplaces
  remove   Remove a configured plugin marketplace
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
